description: Keyless. Norges Bank reference exchange rate for a currency against NOK — the benchmark Norwegian tax and accounting rules accept for foreign-currency obligations. No Norwegian-company input. Input: { base, quote, date? } — ISO 4217 codes, NOK-anchored: exactly one side MUST be 'NOK'. The response is always base NOK and quote = the other currency, whatever order you sent; rate = NOK per 1 unit of quote; date = the day the rate is valid for (weekends and holidays fall back to the prior business day, so it can differ from requested_date). A pair without a NOK side is rejected client-side as UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY_PAIR: derive cross rates from two NOK legs. Failure modes: VALIDATION_FAILED, UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY_PAIR, INVALID_DATE, UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, NO_RATE_AVAILABLE; a credential without `read:norgesbank` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). For obligations or deadlines rather than a rate, use get_company_summary instead. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp
description_nb: Nøkkelfritt. Hent Norges Banks referansekurs for en valuta mot NOK. Inndata: { base, quote, date? } med koder etter ISO 4217, forankret i NOK: nøyaktig én side MÅ være 'NOK', ellers UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY_PAIR. Svaret har alltid base NOK uansett rekkefølgen i kallet, og rate er NOK per 1 enhet av quote; date er dagen kursen gjelder for (helg og helligdag gir forrige virkedag). For forpliktelser eller frister i stedet for en valutakurs, bruk get_company_summary i stedet.

base.description: Base currency — ISO 4217 three-letter code (case-insensitive). Exactly one of base/quote must be 'NOK'.

date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); omit for the latest published rate. Non-business days fall back to the prior business day.

quote.description: Quote currency — ISO 4217 three-letter code (case-insensitive). Exactly one of base/quote must be 'NOK'.

name: get_exchange_rate

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The Norges Bank NOK reference rate, the date it is valid for, and the source attribution.

title: Norges Bank exchange rate (keyless)
